term: truth-directed norm versus ability to recognize correctness
resolution: TruthDirected requires selected worldviews to be true at a specified actual world; it does not give an agent an evidence-dependent way of selecting them. AdmitsCriterion requires only an extensional evidence classifier of a stipulated truth predicate and does not prescribe which worldview ought to be adopted. The warranted correction standard is stronger still: neither model supplies a usable, justified method. No inference from a norm to epistemic access, or from access to normative obligation, is silently made.
